caseNameFull: William A. Calvert, Administrator, etc., in Error v. Southern Railway Company
summary: In error to the Circuit Court of the United States for the District of South Carolina.
attorneys: Mr. William N. Graydon for the plaintiff in error. Mr. George E. Hamilton and Mr. Fairfax Harrison for the defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Judgment affirmed, with costs,- on the authority of St. Louis and San Francisco Railway Company v. James, 161 U. S. 545; and see Calvert v. Southern Railway Company, 64 S. C. 143; 41 S. E. Rep. 963.
